title: Exactness of pullback on module objects
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $f\colon X\to Y$ any morphism of schemes. The pullback of module objects
$$
f^*=\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_f}\circ\operatorname{mapMod}(f^*_{\Ab})\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}
$$
of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] is additive ([def-weil-pbc-additive-functor]) and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. More precisely, both $\operatorname{mapMod}(f^*_{\Ab})\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}\to\Mod_{f^*\Lambda_Y}$ and $\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_f}\colon\Mod_{f^*\Lambda_Y}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ are exact ([def-galois-exact-functor]).

proof.text: Use the already proved source-library instances Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_mapMod and Functor.preservesFiniteColimits_mapMod for transport of the exact abelian inverse image. The ambient abelian, monoidal and tensor-colimit hypotheses are supplied by the canonical pro-etale sheaf instances already used in the definition of module pullback. The source-library upperStar_additive, preservesFiniteLimits_upperStar and preservesFiniteColimits_upperStar give additivity and exactness of the composite pullback itself. These are existing proofs, so the general lifted-exactness theorem and a separate construction of the sheaf tensor are unnecessary here.

source.place: Setting, Transport and Conclusion: specialize the existing source-library exactness instances

proof.text: The canonical coefficient comparison is an invertible monoid morphism by lem-sfb-alpha-ring-hom and lem-sfb-alpha-iso. Mod.extendScalarsIsoComapInv is the already proved natural isomorphism of def-sfb-modobj-extension-along-iso. Its inverse has source the inverse scalar-restriction functor. Mod.preservesFiniteLimits_comap proves finite-limit preservation of this restriction functor. Apply Mathlib preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso to that inverse natural isomorphism to obtain finite-limit preservation of scalar extension. Scalar extension preserves finite colimits as the left adjoint of scalar restriction, by lem-sfb-modobj-extension-right-exact.

source.place: Extension of scalars: transfer finite limits from inverse restriction; use the left-adjoint instance for finite colimits

proof.text: Form the nested conjunction of the seven properties: additivity and finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation of upperStar, then both preservation properties of mapMod, then both preservation properties of scalar extension. Each component is one of the instances established above. No restriction on the scheme morphism or on the characteristic or finiteness of the coefficient ring has been added.
